data.display_address: Sobha Reserve, Wadi Al Safa 2, Dubai
data.long_description:
Experience refined contemporary living in this elegant 5-bedroom, 6-bathroom villa situated in the sought-after Sobha Reserve community. With an expansive 5,812.51 sq. ft. of thoughtfully crafted space, this home delivers a perfect balance of comfort, style, and upscale family living.

The villa welcomes you with a bright and open layout, featuring spacious living and dining areas enhanced by large windows that fill the interior with natural light. Each of the four bedrooms is well-sized and includes built-in wardrobes and modern en-suite bathrooms, offering privacy and convenience for every member of the household. The master suite serves as a peaceful sanctuary, complete with generous storage and a beautifully designed, spa-inspired bathroom.

A sleek, contemporary kitchen fitted with high-quality appliances and premium finishes makes daily cooking and entertaining effortless. Outside, the villa offers ample space for outdoor seating, leisure, and hosting guests—perfect for enjoying quiet evenings or weekend gatherings.

Community Amenities Include:

Resort-style swimming pool
Fully equipped fitness center
Jogging and cycling tracks
Paddle and tennis courts
Children’s play areas
Lush landscaped parks and open green spaces
24/7 gated security
Premium clubhouse facilities

Set within one of Dubai’s most prestigious villa communities, Sobha Reserve combines tranquility and luxury with excellent connectivity to key destinations across the city. Ideal for families seeking a serene residential environment or investors looking for a high-quality asset in a master-planned neighborhood.
